issue.title: Docs describe the canceled bob-cli-6t project pull-in as shipped behavior

task_type_fields.impact: Agents and Bryan reading the docs will expect a close gesture to link and promote an emptied project's ^prj, but nothing does. Either mark the pull-in sections as a pending contract (not shipped) until 6t is re-planned, or remove them and leave them to the re-plan.
task_type_fields.repro:
Epic bob-cli-6t ("Pull an emptied project's ^prj task in as a successor link") was canceled at 2026-10-12T14:51Z, after only its contract phase landed (ec7251e, 6t.1). Its code (task_complete/project_pull_in.rs, `project_empty`/`hide_removed`/`trigger` fields, cycler 088-successor-project.js) never landed. `rg -n 'project_empty|hide_removed' src/` is empty.

The docs still describe the pull-in in the present tense as shipped behavior:
- README.md ~814-816
- docs/projects.md ~160-162
- docs/plan.md ~597
- docs/capture.md ~3444-3446 and ~3478-3482
- docs/task-dependencies.md §12.1 (~787), §12.2 (~810, ~834), §12.5–12.6, §12.10 / §12.11 PP1–PP24, and the §13.4 sentence naming §12.10 as "the one path that makes ^prj Next"
- the code comment at src/native/task_complete/project_close.rs:111-112 ("§12.10 pull-in verdicts")

Bob-cli-6u (the ^prj line model) kept and ported this text at a coordination note's request, so the text is current with the line model, but no code implements it.

issue.creation_reason: Found by bob-cli-6u.land while verifying the 6u docs sweep: 6t was canceled before its code landed, but its §12.10 contract and present-tense pointers remain in README and four docs.

payload.description: The canceled epic whose contract text the docs still present as shipped
